newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SOCCER-UEFA BOSS SAYS TIME FOR HAVELANGE TO GO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-UEFA BOSS SAYS TIME FOR HAVELANGE TO GO.

text.p: European soccer boss Lennart Johansson said on Thursday that FIFA secretary general Joao Havelange was too old to realise that it was time to step down from his throne as supremo of world soccer.
Johansson told the daily Expressen in an interview that if, as expected, he was elected to replace Havelange, he would serve only a single four-year term.
"The time comes when you reach an age when you don't understand that it's time to climb down from the throne. We in Europe think it's time for him to go. He's 81 years old," the Swede said.
Johansson, 67 years old, paid tribute to the Brazilian who has ruled football for 22 years, saying he had held the world of soccer together.
